snippet.title: Foobar Zero: Gameplay trailer
snippet.description:
Step into the arena where movement is your best weapon. Walljump and dodge over your opponents while experimenting with loadouts that range from heavy firepower to mechanic fists and even an oversized wrench. Pick abilities that fit your playstyle, make your character your own, and show off both your skills and your style on the battlefield.
